verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for a commerce/POS platform with an Admin API, but the evidence pack never documents issuing scoped or least-privilege API tokens for agents. The closest items are staff custom roles and PINs, which control human staff permissions, and POS UI extensions calling the GraphQL Admin API, which is a developer building block. Neither delivers agent credential scoping, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
